title: manni content-strategy vocabulary v1.0.0
description: What a content-strategy record says about its parent. A record is a page that declares `type: audience`, `type: persona` or `type: journey`, which `manni strategy` reads. A persona names its audience and a journey names its persona, each with a singular field. `type`, `id`, `title` and `description` belong to manni:core:1.0.0 and are not declared here. Nothing is required. Files without the vocabulary's fields pass.

audience.description: The id of the audience a persona record belongs to. It is singular because a persona belongs to one audience, and it differs from the `audiences` list of manni:audience:1.0.0, which says who a page serves.

persona.description: The id of the persona a journey record belongs to. It is singular because a journey belongs to one persona, and it differs from the `personas` list of manni:audience:1.0.0, which says who a page serves.
